title: Offences in connection with fires
rule: Without lawful authority or excuse (burden on the accused), lighting, rekindling or adding fuel to a fire, leaving a lit fire unattended before it is fully out, or breaching a lawful fire order under Part IX, is an offence.
points: Wilfully and unlawfully setting fire to a forest reserve, plantation, standing trees, saplings or shrubs is a separate, more serious offence, punished under s.321 of the Penal Code (arson) rather than this Act's own penalty.
checks: Was the fire left unattended before fully out
penalty: s.91(1): fine of TSh 50,000 to 1,000,000, or up to 1 year in prison, or both. s.91(2) (wilful arson): penalty under s.321 of the Penal Code, Cap. 16.
